player_prompt.intro:
Uwewe ni Umukino {player_id} mu SimpleTak.
Ku kibo, amabuye yawe aratangazwa nka '{player_stone}' na amabuye ya mukino wawe aratangazwa nka '{opponent_stone}'.

Mu mugoroba wawe, hitamo kigo kigikubye (kwa izina ryaryo) na uvuye iguye mu kigo.
Kwa mfano, '[12]' kuvya iguye mu kigo 12.

Itegeko ryawe ni kubaka uruziga rw'amabuye yawe rushika ibice bibiri byose by'ikibo (kuva hejuru hadi hejuru au kuva kubufaransa hadi kubufaransa).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Inomero y'urupapuro idakwiriye {cell_num}. Itegerezwa kuba iri hagati ya 0 na {max_board_num} .
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Ikirere {cell_num} kirahari. Hitamwo ikirezi kitagira ico kirimwo.

action.placement: Umukino {current_player_id} wavuye ibaro ryawe ({symbol}) mu kigo {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: Urutonde rwuzuye. Ni ubusa ku bundi!
